import html # Example template for a blog post; it should contain `{title}` and `{body}` placeholders BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(heading: str, content: str) -> str: """ Render a blog entry safely for display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The title of the blog post. content : str The main body text of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized, HTML‑escaped string ready for safe display. Raises ------ ValueError If either `heading` or `content` is not a string. """ if not isinstance(heading, str) or not isinstance(content, str): raise ValueError("Both heading and content must be strings.") # Escape special HTML characters to prevent XSS or markup injection safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Use the predefined format to assemble the final HTML formatted = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_heading, body=safe_content) return formatted.strip()
